summary: Retest (iter261) of the P0 billing-gate fixes for suspended/past_due companies. ALL 3 previously reported gaps are FIXED and verified end-to-end. Backend: 29/29 pytest tests pass in /app/backend/tests/test_iter261_billing_gate_retest.py — (a) /api/subscription, /api/plans, /api/invoices, /api/subscription/cancellation-info, /api/billing/renewal-history, /api/payment-method, /api/payment-method/history, /api/billing/status are all reachable (200, no 402) for BOTH suspended and past_due; (b) GET /api/billing/status now returns is_blocked=true for past_due AND suspended, and false for active; (c) business endpoints (/api/employees, /api/dashboard/stats, /api/notifications, /api/payroll/periods) still return 402 with {billing_required:true, subscription_status} for both blocked statuses; /api/subscription payload carries the real status (suspended/past_due) and no Mongo _id; /api/plans returns the 3 real plans. Frontend (Playwright, both suspended and past_due): login redirects to /billing-required; the card shows the blocked variant; the new secondary button data-testid='go-to-subscriptions-btn' is visible and navigates to /subscriptions; /subscriptions renders REAL data now (badge 'suspended'/'past_due', plan Pro, period, usage, plans comparison, Payment Method card, Historial de renovaciones); clicking Add/Update card opens the Stripe card dialog successfully (setup-intent path works) so the auto-recovery flow (change card) is functional; direct navigation to /employees, /dashboard, /payroll while past_due still redirects to /billing-required. DB status RESTORED to 'active' and verified (employees 200, is_blocked=false).

minor.issue: Still 404 — called twice by SubscriptionsPage on every load (pre-existing dead endpoint/wrong path). Remove the call or implement the route.

ui_bugs.issue: With status=past_due the copy says 'Suscripción suspendida / Tu suscripción fue suspendida por falta de pago'. Since is_blocked now covers past_due, the grace-period message (grace_days_left) is never shown. Consider differentiating past_due (grace) vs suspended copy using subscription_status instead of only is_blocked.

Pay button still permanently disabled when the blocked company has no pending invoice (billing-pay-now-btn shows $0.00/mes). Mitigated by the new escape hatch to /subscriptions, but the primary CTA is still a dead control — consider hiding it or generating/fetching the pending invoice.

integration_issues.issue: The app shell still fires non-allowlisted calls that 402 on every render (/api/notifications, /api/notifications/count, /api/hr-alerts, /api/dashboard/stats, /api/onboarding/checklist, /api/country-config/company, /api/search/suggestions). Functionally harmless (page content is correct) but produces ~15 console errors per load and repeated polling; consider suppressing shell fetches when billing.is_blocked.

issues: 'Monthly total' shows $0.00 while base is $20.00 + 6 employees x $1.50 — total_monthly=0 in the subscription document (data/legacy issue, not caused by the gate)
Sidebar shows the full menu (greyed) while every item is gated — acceptable but slightly confusing

action_items: Optional: differentiate past_due vs suspended messaging on /billing-required (show grace_days_left for past_due)
Optional: hide/replace the disabled 'Pagar y activar renovación automática' CTA when there is no pending invoice
Remove or implement the 404 /api/checkout/payment-method call in SubscriptionsPage
Optional: skip app-shell polling calls (notifications, hr-alerts, dashboard/stats, onboarding, country-config, search suggestions) when billing.is_blocked to stop the 402 console noise
critical_code_review_comments: billing_cycle.get_billing_status now duplicates the blocked-status set literal ('suspended','past_due'); import BLOCKED_STATUSES from middleware/billing_gate.py to keep a single source of truth (this exact duplication caused the past_due drift found in iter260)
BillingGateMiddleware still performs 1-2 Mongo queries per authenticated API request with no TTL cache — the blocked /subscriptions page fires ~20 requests per load, all paying that cost

success_rate.frontend: 100% of the 3 fix scenarios + business-block scenario passed

seed_data_creation: None. Only toggled db.subscriptions.status for comp_7bf9f34ab85e (suspended → past_due → active). RESTORED to 'active' and verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: P0 billing-gate is fully verified. Use `python /app/scripts/set_sub_status.py <suspended|past_due|active>` to toggle comp_7bf9f34ab85e and ALWAYS restore to active. Regression suite: /app/backend/tests/test_iter261_billing_gate_retest.py (export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL before pytest). Remaining items are cosmetic/minor: past_due copy on /billing-required, disabled pay CTA with no pending invoice, 404 /api/checkout/payment-method, 402 console noise from app-shell polling.
rca_of_the_issue: Previously the allowlist covered only /api/billing/* and /api/payment-method*, and get_billing_status hardcoded 'suspended'. Fix adds /api/subscription(s), /api/plans, /api/invoices to ALLOWLIST_PREFIXES, sets is_blocked = status in ('suspended','past_due'), and adds the /subscriptions escape hatch on /billing-required. All three verified working; no new regressions found.
